rationale: Explicitly describes an AI-powered feature that monitors agent-user live chat and surfaces available answers to the agent.
ai_type_rationale: Live chat between the agent and user is the conventional core context; AI answer suggestions are an added assistance feature, so meaningful chat functionality remains without that enhancement.
evidence_spans: AI-powered Live Assist feature enables Sia  to consistently monitor the live chat between the agent and the user, and wherever the AI response is available, notify the agent through a pop-up
ai_type_evidence_spans: monitor the live chat between the agent and the user
notify the agent through a pop-up
